import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

posts_file = Path('/home/user/IA-agentes/routines/reports/posts_latest.json')
if not posts_file.exists():
    msg = 'Aún no has generado el informe semanal de IA. Escribe /weekly-news para generarlo.'
    print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': msg}))
    sys.exit(0)

data = json.loads(posts_file.read_text())
generated = data.get('generado_el', '')
week = data.get('semana', '')
current_week = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-W%W')

if week != current_week:
    msg = f'El informe de IA es de la semana {week}. La semana actual es {current_week}. Escribe /weekly-news para actualizarlo.'
    print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': msg}))
else:
    sys.exit(0)
